findings.description: F-001: glavnyj_cikl() was a busy loop with no delay of any kind, so `python snake_basic.py` ran 14 ticks in 2.1 ms and printed «Игра окончена! Счёт: 0» before the player could press a key — while the section said «Запустите игру у себя … управление стрелками клавиатуры» and «Мы построили настоящую работающую игру».
findings.resolution: Added `import time` and `ZADERZHKA_SEK = 0.12` to snake_basic.py and a time.sleep(ZADERZHKA_SEK) call to glavnyj_cikl()'s loop body, keeping the `while igrovoj_shag(): screen.update()` shape so existing quotations in 19.13 and Debug Lab 3 stay accurate. Updated the 19.8 listing to match and added a warning callout carrying the measured numbers and explaining why sleep() is legitimate in a blocking loop but becomes a bug under screen.ontimer() (19.13 / Debug Lab 4). Reworded the closing callout and 19.13's opening from «busy-цикл» to «блокирующий цикл», and replaced Debug Lab 3's now-false CPU-burn symptom. Verified: 14 steps in 1.690 s -> 120.7 ms/step, a human-playable ~8 steps per second.
